source: Make an awesome 3d game featuring an open world concept with large trampolines that bounce the player super high. The player can chain together combos by landing on multiple trampolines in succession. Every time they land on a trampoline in a combo they jump even higher, so that they can jump higher and higher to absurd heights - but once they land on the ground then the next time they jump on a trampoline the bounce height resets (still super high but not as high as during a combo). Way up in the air they can collect stars and other power ups that change the appearance of their character. The better power ups must be higher in elevation so they are harder to reach and require a combo. Make sure the soundtrack is beautiful and chill with lovely strings and piano.

image_prompt.text: The chain of trampolines and floating platforms that forms the route upward, stacked so higher pads sit above lower ones
Large trampolines that boost the player enormously, clustered and lined up so bounces can be chained from one to the next
Platforms that vanish a moment after being landed on
Trusses and ladders on the ascent
The high-altitude payoff area holding the best appearance-changing power-ups
An open ground-level world of grassy terrain with trampolines spread across it, opening into empty sky above

layout_placement.text: The reward volume at the top of the climb, granting the rarest character-changing power-up
Stars floating in the air, placed on lines that only a chained bounce can reach
Power-ups that change the player's appearance, with the better ones placed at greater elevation

notes: Shape is a forced fit: the prompt describes an open world with trampolines scattered across it, and all three obby shapes are linear courses. Tower was chosen because the ascent stacks vertically, which is where the P2 comes from.

The genre's P6 spacing limits (11 studs horizontal, 7.2 vertical) are derived from default jump height and do not describe this game at all - bounce height is the mechanic and it escalates with every combo link.
Bounce height resets on touching the ground; that state machine is scripting, not layout.

open_questions.ask: What should the world look like - dreamy pastel skyscape, natural countryside, something neon?
How high is 'absurd' - a few thousand studs, or genuinely unbounded?

coverage_missing.ask: What is the visual style of the world and the sky?
How tall is the reachable space?
Is collecting every star a win, or is this endless free play?

answers.ask: What should the world look like - dreamy pastel skyscape, natural countryside, something neon?
answers.answer: Use a dreamy pastel skyscape: soft clouds, floating-looking platforms, and a calm airy atmosphere that matches the chill strings-and-piano soundtrack.

answers.ask: How high is 'absurd' - a few thousand studs, or genuinely unbounded?
answers.answer: Make it a few thousand studs high, with the best power-ups placed near the upper elevations; this keeps the world large and rewarding while remaining a focused playable map.
